Your Music Deserves Space to Grow

There comes a point in every flute player’s journey where passion isn’t the problem — direction is. It’s easy to feel stuck, unsure of the next step, or overwhelmed by everything you “could” learn.

Horizons+ gives you a path. Gentle structure, meaningful support, and a community that grows with you — not ahead of you.

And when you join now, you’ll also receive a seat in my live workshop, A Year of Becoming, designed to help you start the year with clarity, confidence, and intention.

Begin the Year With Purpose

Every musician reaches a moment when they want to stop guessing and start growing with intention. Horizons+ gives you the tools, the pathway, and the support to shape the player you want to become, one meaningful step at a time.

With $195 off the annual plan, this is the perfect season to invest in your sound and finally move forward with clarity and confidence. Enrollment is open through December 31, and your next musical chapter is ready when you are.

For less than $1 a day, you can choose a year of direction, encouragement, and intentional growth.

High Spirits - Northwest Signature

This is my first High Spirits flute. I was curious about their signature series - the larger bore and tonality is great. Extremely responsive and very fun to play. Have family in the Northwest, so I had to bring some of the NW to Tennessee. Love the flute and it’s design.

Richard Triggs
zPre-Owned High Spirits Northwest Spirit Signature Flutes

Just what I hoped for

I live in Oregon and had my eye on a High Spirits Northwest Spirit Signature Flute for years, but just couldn't quite convince myself that I "needed" it. When I saw one (a mid-G) on the Pre-Owned Flute page, I knew I had to buy it. It is perfect! Like most mid-range High Spirits flutes, it has a lovely tone and a great high register. Thank you for making the Pre-Owned Flute resource available, both for buyers and for sellers.

Nancy D
zPre-Owned High Spirits Northwest Spirit Signature Flutes
12/03/2025
Songkeepers - 2101 DVD

This is a true treasure! I was so glad to find a copy of the DVD. My very first flute was made by Hawk Littlejohn, whom I met back in 1997. I was very happy to see so much video of him in the video as he only left one cassette tape of music (The Long Human Being) as his legacy - well, plus a whole bunch of flutes that he made.

John Austin

Hi There!

We're Jonny and Maria, the proud owners of Horizons Flute Store and School.

I'm Jonny, with over 20 years of experience with the Native flute. As a community builder, an award-winning educator and recording artist, I pour my heart into teaching at our Horizons Flute School and curating the finest products for our store.

Maria, my better half, is the super-organizer who ensures your orders are handled with care and shipped on time. With her background in therapeudic recreation, she loves helping people and ensures you have the best possible shopping experience with us.

We're not alone in this journey though. We have a fantastic small team that helps us make Horizons what it is. You can learn more about them here.

Together, we balance running our business and raising our four amazing kids - and let's not forget our four adorable dogs! This isn't just a business to us; it's our passion and our livelihood. When you choose to shop with us or enroll in our school, you're supporting our family and enabling us to continue doing what we love: serving our wonderful flute community.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for being a part of our journey. We can't wait to welcome you to the Horizons Flute family!

Warmly,
Jonny & Maria

Who is Jonny Lipford?

I'm a performing and recording artist and educator of Native American flutes. I help new and seasoned flute players find inspiration in their flute journey so they feel motivated, creative and expressive.
